4595426614.title: 1st Wedding Anniversary Gift, Paper Anniversary, Virgo Virgo Couple Printable Art, Virgo Gifts
4595426614.description:
A personalized 1st wedding anniversary gift made from your two zodiac signs, Virgo and Virgo. Your names and your special date are added to your own shared symbol, for married couples and for couples celebrating one year together. A thoughtful choice when you are looking for Virgo gifts.

Every AstroLoveArt design merges two zodiac signs into one shared symbol. This listing is for the Virgo and Virgo symbol shown in the photos.

Every fusion symbol begins as an original AstroLoveArt design. We use AI tools to help create the artwork, and every design is reviewed and finished by us.

HOW TO ORDER
1. Choose your style, your format and your size.
2. Fill in the personalization boxes: the name on the left, the name on the right and your special date (your wedding day or the day you met). Example: Emma, James, 14 June 2025.
3. Heading: "Paper Anniversary" for married couples or "Our First Year" for couples who are dating.
4. Optional short line: up to 20 characters of your own to replace "Year One". Leave it empty to keep "Year One".

FREE PREVIEW BEFORE YOU ORDER
Would you like to see your design first? Message us your names, your date and your chosen style, and we will send you a free preview.

AFTER YOU ORDER
We send your final preview in Etsy Messages within 24 hours. As soon as you approve it, we prepare your file or your print.

DELIVERY
- Digital File: sent to you as a download link via Etsy Messages as soon as you approve your preview.
- Print: made and shipped within 4 to 7 days after your approval, with free shipping worldwide. You can see the estimated delivery time for your country at checkout.

STYLES
Starlit, Timeless, First Page, Layers, Botanical.

FORMATS
- Digital File: one print ready 300 dpi JPG in the style and size you choose, for your own printing. Nothing is shipped.
- Print: printed on matte art paper and shipped to you unframed by our production partner.

SIZES
14 sizes, from 5 x 7 to 24 x 36 inches, plus A4 to A2. Every style and size comes as a print or a digital file.

PLEASE NOTE
The gold, relief and paper layer looks are printed effects in the design. When printed, the design is flat, with no foil, raised layers or cut paper pieces. Colors may look slightly different on screen and on paper.

WHY PAPER
Paper is the traditional gift for the first wedding anniversary. A print of your two signs, your names and your date is a paper gift made only for the two of you.

RETURNS
Every item is personalized, so we can't accept returns or exchanges. Digital files can't be refunded once sent. If your print arrives damaged, send us a photo within 7 days and we'll replace it at no cost.
